title: Understanding One-hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding is a way to represent categorical data as binary vectors. Each unique category is represented by a vector where one element is '1' (hot) and all others are '0'.

title: Calculate the Number of 6-letter Combos
text: To find the number of possible 6-letter combinations, consider that each position in the 6-letter sequence can be one of $$4$$ letters (T, G, C, A).

title: Compute the Total Number of 6-letter Combos
text: Calculate the total number of possible 6-letter combinations using the formula for permutations with repetition.

title: Determine the Dimensionality
text: Each 6-letter combination is represented by a unique dimension in the one-hot encoding. Multiply the number of 6-letter combinations by the number of positions in the DNA string where a 6-letter combo can start.

title: Calculate the Number of Starting Positions
text: Determine how many positions a 6-letter combo can start in a 3000-letter DNA string.

title: Compute the Total Dimensionality
text: Multiply the number of 6-letter combinations by the number of starting positions to find the total dimensionality.

title: Final Calculation
